description: Hand-labelled headline pairs for event clustering. "same" = both headlines report the same underlying development; "different" = distinct events (including hard negatives that share actors, names or event type). Articles come from the production snapshots in tests/fixtures/snapshots/2026-10-29 (origin "snapshot:*") plus hand-written wire-style variants (origin "constructed") covering transliteration, US/UK spelling, demonym and Indian-entity cases. hoursAgo is relative to a common now.
